treatments.relaxing.name: Relaxing Aromatherapy Massage
treatments.relaxing.description: A gentle massage therapy combined with premium aromatic essential oils to melt away fatigue, boost circulation and deliver absolute peace of mind.
treatments.relaxing.details: The treatment uses long gliding strokes combined with gentle kneading at moderate pressure. Premium essential oils absorbed through the skin stimulate the senses, soothe the nervous system and release all accumulated stress from daily life.
treatments.relaxing.benefit1: Quickly reduces mental stress and fatigue
treatments.relaxing.benefit2: Promotes blood circulation and stabilizes heart rate
treatments.relaxing.benefit3: Softens muscles and relieves stress-related headaches
treatments.relaxing.benefit4: Uses imported organic Lavender & Melaleuca essential oils
treatments.deep-tissue.name: Deep Tissue Massage
treatments.deep-tissue.description: Therapeutic massage targeting deep muscle layers and connective tissue. Especially recommended to release chronic muscle tension and persistent pain.
treatments.deep-tissue.details: The perfect therapy for those with chronic muscle pain or athletes. Therapists use finger pressure, elbows and forearms to target deep muscle knots, helping to restore muscle energy.
treatments.deep-tissue.benefit1: Releases hardened muscle knots & chronic pain
treatments.deep-tissue.benefit2: Enhances joint flexibility and range of motion
treatments.deep-tissue.benefit3: Aids removal of lactic acid accumulated post-training
treatments.deep-tissue.benefit4: Precisely targets lower back and neck-shoulder areas
treatments.hot-stone.name: Hot Stone Massage
treatments.hot-stone.description: Warm basalt volcanic stones placed on energy meridians combined with flowing massage movements to relax muscles and soothe the nervous system.
treatments.hot-stone.details: The perfect combination of thermal therapy from natural volcanic stones and traditional meridian pressing techniques. Heat penetrates deep into cells to dissolve tight muscle areas while detoxifying and supporting the natural immune system.
treatments.hot-stone.benefit1: Natural stone warmth effectively detoxifies the body
treatments.hot-stone.benefit2: Stimulates maximum relaxation for deep, quality sleep
treatments.hot-stone.benefit3: Dilates blood vessels, improving whole-body circulation
treatments.hot-stone.benefit4: Reduces nerve tension and soothes anxiety
treatments.facial-care.name: K-Beauty Advanced Facial Care
treatments.facial-care.description: Korean medical-standard facial treatment combining collagen infusion, lifting and facial massage for instantly bright, firm, radiant skin.
treatments.facial-care.details: Premium skin care protocols from Seoul clinics. The process includes deep pore cleansing, stem cell/collagen infusion via ultrasonic ion machine, biological recovery mask and anti-aging acupressure lifting.
treatments.facial-care.benefit1: Deep hydration for glass-skin texture — Korean standard
treatments.facial-care.benefit2: Natural facial lifting, increased elasticity against sagging
treatments.facial-care.benefit3: Fades dark spots for brighter, more even-toned skin
treatments.facial-care.benefit4: Facial acupressure massage for lymphatic detox
treatments.combination.name: Combination Therapy & Aromatherapy Massage
treatments.combination.description: The perfect blend of therapeutic stretching movements and muscle softening through warm herbal aromatherapy.
treatments.combination.details: Designed specifically for office workers and those with spinal issues. A unique blend of traditional Thai stretching and gentle Swedish oil massage to restore spinal and joint flexibility.
treatments.combination.benefit1: Completely releases energy blockages in the body
treatments.combination.benefit2: Restores spinal flexibility and bone joint mobility
treatments.combination.benefit3: Reduces back and neck pain from poor sitting posture
treatments.combination.benefit4: Warm herbal aromatherapy calms the mind
treatments.foot-scrub.name: Foot Scrub & Massage
treatments.foot-scrub.description: Warm salt grain exfoliation for feet, followed by reflexology massage to relax tired feet from sole to calf.
treatments.foot-scrub.details: Protect your feet — the foundation of your health. The process combines warm herbal deodorizing foot soak, natural mineral salt heel exfoliation and deep reflexology massage stimulating healthy organ function.
treatments.foot-scrub.benefit1: Removes hardened calluses, heals cracked heels
treatments.foot-scrub.benefit3: Reduces foot swelling and calf muscle aches
treatments.foot-scrub.benefit4: Promotes better sleep through deep foot meridian relaxation
treatments.body-scrub.name: Full Body Scrub
treatments.body-scrub.description: Meticulous Korean-style exfoliation to remove rough dead skin, stimulate new cell growth for bright, smooth, healthy skin.
treatments.body-scrub.details: The perfect method for silky smooth body skin. Uses organic coffee/rice bran blend with premium fresh milk combined with gentle scrubbing technique to remove aged dead skin layers and promote fresh, rosy new skin cell regeneration.
treatments.body-scrub.benefit1: Deep cleanses rough dead skin cells across the entire body
treatments.body-scrub.benefit2: Helps improve back acne and folliculitis conditions
treatments.body-scrub.benefit3: Stimulates bright, smooth new skin cell growth
treatments.body-scrub.benefit4: Enhances body lotion absorption after treatment
